_comment: VERIFIED working template for a file-only room agent (claude 2.1.274, interactive mode).
Generated per agent by `hive spawn` — do not hand-edit inside a room; room.yaml is the source of truth.
Substitutions: {{HIVE_BIN}} = hive's bin dir on the AGENT's filesystem (WSL path, not /mnt/d).
Launch with env on the command itself:
env HIVE_ROOM_ROOT=<room> HIVE_LOG_DIR=<logs outside room> PATH=<minimal> claude --settings <this file> --strict-mcp-config
A shell `export` before `claude` does NOT reach the hook child. See docs/RUNTIME.md.
